output.reason: [ev-a1ca6a9f17f1] only says the HTTP handler `/ingester/flush_shutdown` was removed. It never mentions `--ingester.flush-on-shutdown`, and that flag does not decide whether anything calls the removed endpoint, so the proposed condition flags the wrong environments. Only callers of the endpoint are exposed. A workload preStop hook pointing at the path can be seen in the config: [ev-73055e956e96] shows preStop hooks call ingester shutdown endpoints. External scripts or clients calling it are runtime-only and are marked undecidable.

correction.statement: Loki 3.0.0 removes the legacy ingester HTTP handler `/ingester/flush_shutdown`. Exposed: environments whose workloads point a preStop httpGet hook at that path, or whose external scripts or clients call it at runtime.

of.needed: whether any external script, operator tooling or client calls /ingester/flush_shutdown at runtime
